hooks.command: file="$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if [[ "$file" == *Cargo.lock ]] || [[ "$file" == *.generated.rs ]]; then echo 'BLOCK: Do not edit lock files or generated code directly. Use cargo for lock files and just codegen for generated code.' >&2; exit 2; fi

file="$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if [[ "$file" == *CONSTITUTION.md ]]; then echo 'BLOCK: CONSTITUTION.md is an invariant document. Changes require a DECISIONS.md entry under the governed change process.' >&2; exit 2; fi
